Connect PolyAI to telephony, CRM, payments, and knowledge platforms. Your agent can hand off to live agents, look up reservations, create tickets, and retrieve knowledge articles during calls. All integrations listed here are available from **Integrations** in Agent Studio.Integrations have pre-configured operations for commonly used capabilities of each integration’s API. In some cases, you can add to or modify the available operations to suit the needs of your agent and the scope of your integration.

## [​](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/introduction\#chat)  Chat

Text-based messaging channels and CCaaS handoff.

[**SMS** \\
\\
Send and receive text messages](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/message-templates)

[**Chat handoff** \\
\\
Hand off webchat and SMS to Salesforce, Zendesk, NICE CXone, Amazon Connect, Genesys, Webex, or Five9](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/chat/introduction)

WhatsApp is also available in Agent Studio.

## [​](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/introduction\#crm)  CRM

Caller context, ticket management, and customer data lookup.

[**Salesforce CRM** \\
\\
Access customer records and manage cases](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/salesforce)

Zendesk CRM, HubSpot, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 are also available in Agent Studio.

## [​](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/introduction\#hospitality)  Hospitality

[**OpenTable** \\

## [​](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/introduction\#healthcare)  Healthcare

Electronic health record (EHR) systems for scheduling and patient data.

[**Epic** \\
\\
Connect to Epic EHR for patient data access](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/epic)

Cerner (Oracle Health), eClinicalWorks, ModMed, NextGen, and Raintree are also available in Agent Studio.

## [​](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/introduction\#knowledge)  Knowledge

External knowledge sources for article and answer retrieval during calls.

[**Gladly** \\
\\
Pull articles from your Gladly knowledge base](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/gladly)

Zendesk Knowledge Management, Salesforce Knowledge Management, and Azure AI Search are also available in Agent Studio.

## [​](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/introduction\#mcp)  MCP

Any external tool that exposes an MCP server. Agent Studio discovers available functions automatically.

[**MCP integrations** \\
\\
Add MCP servers and manage tool access](https://docs.poly.ai/mcp/agent-studio-integrations)

## [​](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/introduction\#don%E2%80%99t-see-your-platform)  Don’t see your platform?

Build a custom integration using the [APIs tab](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/api/introduction). Define HTTP endpoints, configure per-environment base URLs and authentication, and call them from Python functions using `conv.api`.For integrations not available in Agent Studio (DNI pooling, Stripe, and others), see the [Managed services](https://docs.poly.ai/integrations/managed-services) section.
